![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14225232/assets/b375c1e162a9f1c2892903c20606921673498579f9b41f633447832fd3ea2192.png)

The scatter plot for the data sets $x$ and $y$ of paired observations and the corresponding linear regression line are shown above.

According to the regression model, what is the residual for the highlighted datapoint?
question.worked_solution:
The residual equals the difference between the actual value of the dependent variable and the value estimated using the linear regression model:

$$
\text{Residual}=\text{Actual}-\text{Estimated}
$$

 

The highlighted datapoint has coordinates $(4,70).$ So, our actual value is $y=70.$

On the other hand, the point on the regression line that corresponds to $x=4$ has the $y$-coordinate $50.$ So, our estimated value of is $\overset{^}{y}=50.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14225232/assets/041f64255345edf7ac37bd61e0ab97a93cc2696f028a53ba0896e0659966c2d8.png)

 

Therefore, the residual is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Residual} & =\text{Actual}-\text{Estimated} \\  & =y-\overset{^}{y} \\  & =70-50 \\  & =20.\end{aligned}
$$
